## Checklist

- [ ] `bash tests/run.sh` passes (and a new test covers the change)
- [ ] `shellcheck` and `shfmt -d` are clean
- [ ] Help text updated and `tools/gen-docs.sh` re-run, if a function changed
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` updated under the unreleased version
- [ ] No breaking change to a documented function, envelope or setting (or it is called out above)
